aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but the changed-factor grouping and metric/spec extraction are not reliable.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not the tested condition.
Baseline/test conditions are left undefined despite supplier and line context.
Supplier, line/machine, C2/E2, and old-data contexts are mixed.
Specs are misassigned, causing false violation counts.
Some cited outcome rows lack enough header/context linkage.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the primary comparison supplier, line/machine, C2 vs E2, or combined?
Should old/SMG old sheets be historical baseline or reference only?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor from source context, likely supplier and/or line-machine comparison.
Preserve subgroup keys: date, line, machine, supplier, lot, and magnet type.
Rebuild outcomes by metric: SMG short, SMG long, CMG, Yoke Semi.
Apply correct specs: SMG short >800, SMG long >1000, CMG >1100, Yoke Semi >480.
Separate current test sheets from old/reference sheets unless baseline is proven.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but citations are insufficient until headers and grouping rows are correctly paired.
